note: Henry County IN publishes zoning districts only as a Schneider Beacon viewer layer ('County Zoning', 'NC Zoning', no public REST endpoint) and PDF ordinance/map documents; official zoning maps are kept at the Planning Commission office. The county ArcGIS Online org (osmyvTbXDC07yFxn) has HenryCountyZoning and HenryZoningLayer, but those hold Henry County, OHIO zoning (Napoleon/Deshler area near -84.0 lon), not Indiana. New Castle's Zoning Map is only linked, with no queryable service found.
